  A first draft — edit it to sound like you before you post it. Nothing here is

  Two things worth keeping if you rewrite it:
    - The thanks comes first. The asks are secondary, and one sentence each.
    - The rating is framed as the alternative for someone who won't or can't

  The sponsorship link is the one declared in .github/FUNDING.yml; if that file

# Close reply

Paste one of these when closing an issue. Pick by how it was closed.

## Fixed

```markdown
Thanks for reporting this — it's fixed, and the change will be in the next release.

If you'd like to support Kanso, I'm on [GitHub Sponsors](https://github.com/sponsors/aktasfatih). And if sponsoring isn't for you, [rating the app](https://apps.nextcloud.com/apps/kanso) helps just as much.
```

## Closed without a change

For a duplicate, a wontfix, or anything else that ends without a fix. Say why in
the first line — the thanks is genuine either way.

```markdown
Thanks for taking the time to write this up. I'm closing it here — <reason> — but it was useful to hear.

If you'd like to support Kanso, I'm on [GitHub Sponsors](https://github.com/sponsors/aktasfatih). And if sponsoring isn't for you, [rating the app](https://apps.nextcloud.com/apps/kanso) helps just as much.
```
